meta.source: migrated from v1 artifact (JEJU_LOCATIONS); re-geocoded to real coordinates via Google Maps Scraper (Apify) when the illustrated single-image build was replaced with a real MapLibre map

places.name: Hallasan
places.note: South Korea's tallest peak and a dormant volcano — the crater lake sits right at the summit, and the whole island fans out from it.

places.name: Youngduam Rock
places.note: A dragon-head-shaped lava rock on the north coast, right at the water's edge — a quick stop, best near sunset.

places.name: Woljeong-ri Beach
places.note: White sand and turquoise water lined with cafés — one of the most photographed beaches on the island.

places.name: Dol Hareubang
places.note: The volcanic-rock guardian statues that are basically Jeju's mascot — originals are scattered around Jeju City.

places.name: Manjanggul Cave
places.note: A huge lava tube you can walk through — one of the longest in the world, cool and echoey year-round.

places.name: Seongsan Ilchulbong
places.note: The 'Sunrise Peak' tuff cone on the east tip — a UNESCO site and the classic Jeju sunrise hike.

places.name: Hyeopjae Beach
places.note: West-coast beach with a view of Biyangdo island offshore — calmer and less crowded than Woljeong-ri.

places.name: Osulloc Tea Museum
places.note: Green-tea fields and a museum/café — the green tea ice cream is the actual reason to go.

places.name: Jusangjeolli Cliff
places.note: Hexagonal basalt columns stacked up by the surf — dramatic in person, especially with waves crashing.

places.name: Cheonjiyeon Falls
places.note: 'Sky-connected-to-land' waterfall near Seogwipo — a short, easy walk through forest to reach it, lit up at night.

places.name: Jeongbang Falls
places.note: A rare waterfall that drops straight into the ocean, near Cheonjiyeon. New pin on this artwork — best guess at which waterfall this second one is meant to be.

places.name: Arte Museum
places.note: An immersive digital-art museum in Aewol — huge projected light/nature installations, one of the most Instagram-friendly stops on the island.

places.name: Colline Jeju
places.note: A café on the west coast.

places.name: Comma
places.note: A café on the west side of the island.

places.name: Haejigae Cafe
places.note: The name points to a sunset view.

places.name: Hallim Park
places.note: The botanical garden and lava-tube park near Hyeopjae Beach.

places.name: Lazy Pump
places.note: A café on the north coast.

places.name: Jejudang Bakery Cafe
places.note: A bakery café.

places.name: Slowboat Atelier
places.note: A café near the north coast.

places.name: Black Ranch
places.note: A ranch/pasture-style café inland.
